## Overview

NEO-Nature is an exploratory data project examining whether Near-Earth Object (NEO) characteristics show any measurable relationship with the frequency of natural disaster events on Earth.

This site contains:

- A reproducible `Tutorial` that runs the data cleaning and analysis pipelines
- `Documentation` describing the package structure and key functions

## Repository Layout

- `src/NEO_Nature/`: Python package source
- `data/`: input datasets and merged output
- `notebooks/`: exploratory work
